description: Source code defining a Pinecone vector store implementation and a node class for integration with LlamaIndex, including methods for upserting, querying, and managing Pinecone indices within a larger application.

classes.name: PineconeLlamaIndex_VectorStores
classes.description: Implements a node for Pinecone vector store integration, supporting upsert and index initialization.

classes.name: PineconeVectorStore
classes.description: A class managing interactions with Pinecone, including adding, querying, deleting, and index management.

methods.name: vectorStoreMethods
methods.description: Contains the upsert method for adding documents to Pinecone.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes a Pinecone index or retriever based on node data inputs.

methods.name: getDb
methods.description: Lazy loads and caches the Pinecone client instance.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Retrieves the specific Pinecone index object.

methods.name: clearIndex
methods.description: Deletes all entries in the index.

methods.name: add
methods.description: Adds embedding results to the Pinecone index.

methods.name: saveChunk
methods.description: Saves a chunk of data to the index namespace.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a document by reference ID from the index.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Performs a similarity search query on the index.

methods.name: persist
methods.description: Placeholder for persisting the vector store (currently does nothing).

methods.name: textFromResultRow
methods.description: Extracts text from a query result row.

methods.name: nodeToRecord
methods.description: Converts a node to a record suitable for Pinecone upsert.
